Subject: SIG profile: clarification on encryption and data residency

Hi Markus,

Thanks for the SIG submission earlier this week — a couple quick clarifications from Acme's side so we can finish our review: 

1) KMS / key management: the SIG notes 'Customer data encrypted at rest using KMS-managed keys'. Can you confirm whether Redwood uses a customer-specific CMK (Customer Master Key) per tenant in production, or a shared Redwood-managed keyring? If you use customer CMKs, please indicate KMS provider (AWS KMS / GCP KMS / other) and provide a short policy snippet or link.

2) Network diagram: we need a simple diagram highlighting where unencrypted data may traverse (if any) and whether there are private VPC endpoints for your dedicated deployment. A PDF is fine.

3) CAIQ mapping: we saw the high-level answers but would like a short spreadsheet mapping the SIG question IDs we flagged to the evidence artifacts you intend to upload (example: SIG-Q-EN-03 -> kms_policy_snippet.txt).

Could you get the items above by EOD next Thursday (2027-04-08)? If this timing doesn't work, propose alternates.

Thanks — appreciate the quick turn.

Leah Turner

Hi Leah — thanks for the clear list. High-level answers below, and I've looped in Monica (security/compliance) and Ben (infrastructure) to provide the artifacts.

- KMS / key management: We use customer-specific CMKs for Dedicated deployments and offer customer-keying via AWS KMS (customer-managed CMKs). For our Hosted API, keys are managed by Redwood; we support a bring-your-own-key (BYOK) option for enterprise customers. Monica will attach a short KMS policy snippet and clarify the BYOK flow.

- Network diagram: Ben will assemble a minimal network diagram for Dedicated and Hosted modes, showing VPC endpoints, any public egress points, and where TLS termination occurs. Note: no unencrypted traffic leaves the customer VPC in Dedicated; Hosted uses TLS in transit and encrypted at rest.

- CAIQ mapping: I will work with Ben and Monica to produce a one-sheet mapping (CAIQ/SIG question -> evidence filename). Expect a spreadsheet and the network diagram.

Target: we'll aim for end-of-day 2027-04-08 and will let you know earlier if we can get items sooner.

Markus Klein
Head of Sales Engineering, Redwood Inference
markus.klein@redwoodinference.com
